intent: Navigate to the app and take intro screenshot
expectation: Intro screen shown with Start test and Generate options
outcome_note: Intro screen loaded correctly with title, description, Start test and Generate a fresh test with AI buttons

intent: Click Start test to begin the quiz
expectation: Page transitions to question 1 with a visual puzzle and answer options
outcome_note: Question 1 of 5 appeared: a sequence puzzle showing a square rotating +45 degrees each step, with 4 answer options

intent: Select Option D (square rotated 270°) for Q1 — pattern adds 45° each step so 225°+45°=270°
expectation: Option D becomes highlighted/pressed and Next button becomes enabled

args.name: Option D — 1 outline medium square, rotated 270°

outcome_note: Option D now shows [pressed] state and Next button became enabled — selection registered correctly

intent: Click Next to advance from Q1 to Q2
expectation: Question 2 appears with a new visual puzzle
outcome_note: Question 2 of 5 appeared: an analogy puzzle — half squares:solid squares :: half triangles:?

intent: Select Option B (solid triangles) for Q2 — half→solid fill transformation, keeping same shape
expectation: Option B gets pressed and Next becomes enabled

args.name: Option B — 3 solid large triangles, rotated 315°

outcome_note: Option B is now [pressed] and Next button enabled — answer recorded

intent: Click Next to advance to Q3
expectation: Question 3 appears with a new puzzle
outcome_note: Question 3 of 5 appeared: odd-one-out with 5 circles options — different fills, counts, and sizes

intent: Select Option D for Q3 — 3 half medium circles, differs in both fill and size from the main group
expectation: Option D gets pressed and Next becomes enabled

args.name: Option D — 3 half medium circles, rotated 90°

outcome_note: Option D is now [pressed] and Next enabled

intent: Click Back from Q3 to return to Q2 and verify my earlier answer (Option B — triangles) is still selected
expectation: Q2 shows with Option B (solid triangles) still pressed as I selected it
outcome_note: Q2 showed, but Option D (circles) was [pressed] instead of Option B (triangles) which I had selected — the wrong answer is shown as selected after Back

mental_state.note: app shows D pressed for Q2 but I answered B — possible state preservation bug on Back

intent: Go Back again from Q2 to Q1 to check my first answer is preserved
expectation: Q1 shows with Option D (square rotated 270°) still pressed as I selected it
outcome_note: Q1 shows correctly with Option D pressed — Q1 state IS preserved after Back navigation

intent: Click Next from Q1 expecting to go to Q2
expectation: Q2 appears with an analogy puzzle showing my earlier answer
outcome_note: Instead of Q2, the app jumped directly to Q4 — skipped Q2 and Q3 entirely after coming back from navigating backwards

mental_state.note: app jumped to Q4 after Next from Q1, skipping Q2 and Q3

intent: Select Option C (solid large stars) for Q4 — column 3 pattern is solid large, row 3 is stars
expectation: Option C pressed and Next enabled
outcome_note: Option C is [pressed] and Next enabled — answer recorded for Q4

intent: Click Next from Q4 to advance to Q5 (last question)
expectation: Q5 appears with a new puzzle and a See results button
outcome_note: Q5 appeared — a sequence with triangles changing fill and rotation, with 5 options and a disabled See results button

intent: Select Option E (solid medium triangles rotated 135°) for Q5 — fill cycles solid→half→outline→solid, rotation decreases by 90° each step
expectation: Option E gets pressed and See results becomes enabled

args.name: Option E — 3 solid medium triangles, rotated 135°

outcome_note: Option E is [pressed] and See results button became enabled — all 5 questions answered

intent: Click See results to view final score and per-question review
expectation: A results screen shows total score, whether each question was right/wrong, and the correct answers
